correctness.rationale: A direct unconditional rank proof distinguishes incoming and outgoing maxima among w+1 values. Conditioned incoming maximum is Beta(w+1,1); conditional outgoing-maximum event makes the retained second-highest value Beta(w,2) at an independent uniform interior location. Independent future samples yield all finite survival laws. Harmonic sums, stationary random-time formula, endpoint atom and both weak limits follow rigorously, including w=1. Exhaustive permutations corroborate at w=1..4.

value.rationale: This gives a complete exact natural lifetime law for equality plateaus of a widely used sliding-block maxima statistic, not an arbitrary one-off enumeration. The two physical renewal mechanisms have sharply different survival laws; the posterior of the upward mechanism increases linearly with survival; the full-window atom persists at 1/4, while time-stationary forward recurrence has a distinct atomless scaling limit. This distinction is relevant to repeated maxima and dependence interpretation; no downstream inference-performance claim is made.
